قفزت أسعار الذهب، الاثنين، بنسبة 3.8% إلى 3692 دولاراً للأونصة، مدعومة بتراجع الدولار وعوائد سندات الخزانة الأمريكية، بعد أسبوع شهد أكبر خسائر للمعدن النفيس منذ مارس/آذار الماضي. وبحلول الساعة 15:30 بتوقيت غرينتش، بلغ سعر الذهب 3692 دولاراً للأونصة، متعافياً من خسائر أسبوعية بلغت نحو 9%، وهي الأكبر خلال 8 أشهر. وجاء الارتفاع مع تراجع الدولار وعوائد السندات الأمريكية، ما عزز جاذبية الذهب الذي لا يدر عائداً، وجعله أقل تكلفة لحائزي العملات الأخرى، إلى جانب إقبال المستثمرين على الشراء عند الأسعار المنخفضة. وكان المعدن الأصفر تعرض لضغوط بيعية حادة خلال الأسبوع الماضي، وسط تصاعد المخاوف بشأن تقييمات شركات الذكاء الصناعي وتزايد التوقعات بتشديد السياسة النقدية الأمريكية، بالتزامن مع موجة بيع واسعة في الأسواق العالمية، ولا سيما أسهم شركات التكنولوجيا. #تفاعل ليصل إليك كل جديد

#Iran Iran is using all available means at its disposal to resist the naval blockade by the United States, said Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Baghai at a weekly press conference on Monday. The US blockade on oil exports related to Iran was imposed on April 13, lifted in June after Washington reached a preliminary agreement with Tehran, and then reinstated on July 14 after the agreement fell through. "We categorically will not tolerate this and will use all available means to counter this US aggression," Baghai stated. Iranian oil exports have dropped almost to zero due to the blockade. Iran claims it controls the passage through the strategically important Strait of Hormuz and will open it only when Washington fulfills its conditions, including a cessation of hostilities, lifting the blockade, and lifting sanctions. Government discusses introducing screening certificates for video games The government is considering a requirement to register projects in the Roskomnadzor registry and store data within Russia, similar to film distribution rules. Market participants warn this could restrict international studios from entering the Russian market and provoke retaliatory measures against domestic developers. Vasily Ovchinnikov, head of the Video Game Industry Development organisation, stated the mechanism is unsuitable as games are evolving services with daily updates, seasons, and player-generated content that render release-day descriptions obsolete. @Slavyangrad

Washington Governor Bob Ferguson condemned the detention of a father and daughter by masked ICE agents at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, describing the footage as “horrific” and “chilling.” He called on Alaska Airlines and other carriers operating at Sea-Tac to demand that ICE leave their airports. Footage recorded by travelers on Saturday showed agents detaining Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza and his daughter, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, on the jet bridge as they prepared to board a flight bound for Los Angeles. The incident delayed the flight and quickly went viral across social media. Demonstrators gathered inside and around the airport on Sunday, carrying signs reading “ICE out of Washington” and “Abolish ICE” while chanting against the agency's operations.
